title: P1 Architect: resolve static RBAC inventory mappings and PII classifications
body: Separate architecture/security assessment and any subsequent product fixes. Resolve statically unbound endpoint authorization against actual guards/policies and classify name-based PII candidates. An unresolved static role is not proof an endpoint is unprotected; an unlabeled name-based candidate is not proof of a legal violation. Preserve tenant/RLS request roles and SENATRAN adapter boundaries.
